title: Meta and Groq Collaborate to Deliver Fast Inference for the Official Llama API

facts.fact: Groq states that with Groq infrastructure, the Llama API offers speeds of up to 625 tokens/sec throughput (vendor claim).
facts.quote: Speeds of up to 625 tokens/sec throughput

facts.fact: Groq says developers need only three lines of code to migrate from OpenAI to the Llama API on Groq infrastructure.
facts.quote: just three lines of code to migrate from OpenAI

facts.fact: Groq states that more than 1.4 million developers already use Groq (vendor claim).
facts.quote: more than 1.4 million developers already use Groq

facts.fact: Groq's boilerplate says over a million developers use Groq (vendor claim).
facts.quote: Over a million developers use Groq to build fast and scale smarter.

facts.fact: The Llama 4 API model accelerated by Groq was in preview at announcement, available to select developers, with broader rollout planned in the coming weeks.
facts.quote: The Llama API is available to select developers in preview

facts.fact: Groq announced the Meta partnership for the official Llama API on April 29, 2025.
